svg.title: Ammar Munir
svg.desc: Lead engineer at Arq Tech. An animated agent built on the Claude Agent SDK takes the task research 3 competitors, update the CRM and draft a pricing brief. It plans the workflow, runs 3 research subagents in parallel, reads 42 web sources, uses RAG over past deals and sales docs, calls MCP tools for HubSpot, Notion and Slack, recalls account history from Mem0 memory, builds a pricing model in Python and gets human approval in Slack.
svg.text: I build AI agents, workflows, integrations and RAG that run in production.

g.text: research 3 competitors, update the CRM and draft a pricing brief

text.tspan: Pricing brief drafted from 42 cited sources, 3 CRM deals
updated, summary posted to Slack after one approval.

g.text: 3 subagents, 57 tool calls, hooks on every write
